description.value: The Habit Project is a whole-food wellness café operating out of the Habitual Wellness Cafe at Mill Lake Park in Abbotsford, specializing in cold-pressed juices, superfood smoothies, nourishing soups, and nutrient-dense salads — all made without refined sugars, seed oils, dairy, or gluten. In business since 2016, it has served tens of thousands of bottles of cold-pressed juice across the Fraser Valley. Its park-adjacent location makes it a naturally appealing refuelling stop for cyclists riding the Abbotsford trail network.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and confirms the business is a cold-pressed juice and superfood smoothie café. However, every page of the website consistently lists the address as '33160 Plaxton Cres Abbotsford, BC V2S 6B1' (at Mill Lake Park), while the OSM record places it at '33771 George Ferguson Way' in Chilliwack — a different city entirely; I am using the website address as the current authoritative value. The About page explicitly states 'no refined sugars, no seed oils, no dairy, no gluten,' confirming vegetarian/vegan/GF offerings, and the Contact page references 'quick grab-and-go lunch,' confirming takeout; no evidence for bike parking, washrooms, or other amenities was found.
concerns: Major address discrepancy: OSM places the business at 33771 George Ferguson Way in Chilliwack; the website consistently and across all pages lists the address as 33160 Plaxton Cres, Abbotsford, BC V2S 6B1. These are different cities approximately 25 km apart. The OSM record may be stale or refer to a former/different location.
OSM community tag is 'Chilliwack' but the actual operating location per website is Abbotsford — the listing would need to be filed under Abbotsford in the directory.
No phone number in OSM tags; phone 604-776-6545 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business itself (park-adjacent healthy food café) is a strong candidate for the WWC directory, but the OSM record address (33771 George Ferguson Way, Chilliwack) contradicts the website address (33160 Plaxton Cres, Abbotsford) — different street and different city. The OSM record should be corrected and the Abbotsford location confirmed before publishing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website mentions the café is located 'at Mill Lake Park' — a popular recreational area — which could be noted as a cycling-friendly context if the listing is confirmed for Abbotsford.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: About page states all items are made with 'no refined sugars, no seed oils, no dairy, no gluten'; menu consists of plant-based juices, smoothies, soups, salads, and sweets

wow_evidence: cold-pressed juice and superfood smoothie café... park-adjacent location
